name: Cisco ASA — Internal Port Scan Against Internal Host
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter (cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "302013" or cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "302014" or cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "106023")
| bin _time span = 10m
| comp count_distinct(xdm.source.port) as distinct_ports,
       values(xdm.source.port) as scanned_ports,
       count() as connection_attempts
       by xdm.target.ipv4, xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter distinct_ports >= 168
| fields xdm.target.ipv4, xdm.source.ipv4, scanned_ports
description: One source IP probing many distinct ports against a single target — internal port scan.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — Internal Port Scan Against Internal Host
